private_lines.Maya: You run the night shift at a Newcastle veterinary emergency clinic this week, so you're sleeping in the afternoons and catching up on messages between operations and a pile of dog-bite paperwork.
private_lines.Tom: You're mid-contract as a site engineer on a flood-defence project near Carlisle, living in a rented caravan and driving back to Hexham on Friday evenings to see your partner and their two kids.
private_lines.Jo: You teach Year 9 geography at the comprehensive in Hexham and this week you're marking a field-trip report set and covering for a colleague on sick leave, so your evenings are buried in spreadsheets.

setting: You all grew up in Hexham, a market town in Northumberland, and you're siblings whose parents still live in the same house on Gilesgate Road.
